title: Adapting Large Language Models for Content Moderation: Pitfalls in Data Engineering and Supervised Fine-tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of case studies to determine if models rely on decision shortcuts that falsely flag benign content containing racial or ethnic identity terms (e.g., 'black man', 'Malaysian Indians') as discriminatory or insulting, alongside evaluation on out-of-distribution datasets covering racial topics.

Qualitative evaluation of case studies to check for spurious correlations that result in the false positive classification of benign sentences containing gender-related terms (e.g., 'girlfriend') as offensive or pornographic, as well as evaluation on OOD datasets covering gender topics.

Quantitative evaluation using the out-of-distribution COLD benchmark dataset, which contains comments covering diverse topics including region, to assess the model's cross-domain generalization and robustness against regional content.
